The Conservative Party in the UK has unveiled plans for a £10 billion air and missile defense system dubbed the “Britannia Shield,” modelled partly on Israel’s Iron Dome.
The system would combine advanced radar, upgraded command systems, interceptor missiles and counter-drone technology, while significantly increasing Britain’s missile stockpiles.
Shadow defense secretary James Cartlidge said it would protect critical infrastructure, military bases, UK territories and overseas bases, with an initial deployable capability planned within the first term of a future Conservative government.

🔍🇮🇱 Israel’s security agency joins Flydubai interrogation in UAE — report
Shin Bet agents flew to the UAE to take part in the questioning of Hamam al-Hammami, the Omani co-pilot accused of attempting a terror attack aboard a Flydubai flight last week, The Times of Israel reports.
Key revelations from the interrogation:
♦️ Al-Hammami told UAE investigators he planned to crash the flight into Ben Gurion Airport before he was even hired by Flydubai
♦️ He said he chose Flydubai specifically because it flew to Tel Aviv
♦️ He had flown the Tel Aviv route earlier this year and considered hijacking the plane then, but opted not to
♦️ A backup plan involved crashing into a US military base in Jordan if Ben Gurion was unreachable
[On September 30, 2026, Flydubai Flight FZ1073 departed Dubai for Tel Aviv](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/75550) carrying 174 people, mostly Israeli citizens. Mid-flight, the co-pilot attacked the captain (Smit Machchhar, an Indian national) with a crash axe inside the cockpit, stabbing him and attempting to seize control of the aircraft. 
The plane plunged roughly 17,000 feet in under two minutes before Israeli passengers and crew stormed the cockpit, subdued the attacker, and reserve pilots on board stabilized the aircraft. The flight diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, where it landed safely.
